text_en: In those days when there was again a great crowd without anything to eat, he called his disciples and said to them,
text_cn: 当那些日子，又有一大群人，没有什么吃的了。耶稣叫过门徒来，给他们说：

text_en: “I have compassion for the crowd, because they have been with me now for three days and have nothing to eat.
text_cn: “我很怜悯这批群众，因为他们同我在一起已经三天，也没有什么可吃的了。

text_en: If I send them away hungry to their homes, they will faint on the way—and some of them have come from a great distance. ”
text_cn: 我若遣散他们空着肚子各自回家，他们必要在路上晕倒；况且他们中还有些是从远处来的。”

text_en: His disciples replied, “How can one feed these people with bread here in the desert? ”
text_cn: 门徒回答说：“在这荒野里，人从哪里能得饼，使这些人吃饱呢？”

text_en: He asked them, “How many loaves do you have? ” They said, “Seven. ”
text_cn: 耶稣问他们说：“你们有多少饼？”他们说：“七个。”

text_en: Then he ordered the crowd to sit down on the ground; and he took the seven loaves, and after giving thanks he broke them and gave them to his disciples to distribute; and they distributed them to the crowd.
text_cn: 耶稣就吩咐群众坐在地上，拿起那七个饼来，祝谢了，掰开，递给他的门徒，叫他们分开；他们就给群众分开。

text_en: They had also a few small fish; and after blessing them, he ordered that these too should be distributed.
text_cn: 又有几条小鱼，耶稣祝福后，也吩咐把这些小鱼分开。

text_en: They ate and were filled; and they took up the broken pieces left over, seven baskets full.
text_cn: 人都吃饱了，把剩下来的碎块收集了七篮子。

text_en: Now there were about four thousand people. And he sent them away.
text_cn: 人数约有四千；然后耶稣遣散了他们，

text_en: And immediately he got into the boat with his disciples and went to the district of Dalmanutha.
text_cn: 即刻同门徒上船，来到了达玛奴达境内。

text_en: The Pharisees came and began to argue with him, asking him for a sign from heaven, to test him.
text_cn: 法利塞人出来，开始和他辩论，向他要求一个来自天上的征兆，想试探他。

text_en: And he sighed deeply in his spirit and said, “Why does this generation ask for a sign? Truly I tell you, no sign will be given to this generation. ”
text_cn: 耶稣从心里叹息说：“为什么这一世代要求征兆？我实在告诉你们，必不给这世代一个征兆！”

text_en: And he left them, and getting into the boat again, he went across to the other side.
text_cn: 他就离开他们，再上船往对岸去了。

text_en: Now the disciples had forgotten to bring any bread; and they had only one loaf with them in the boat.
text_cn: 门徒忘了带饼，在船上除了一个饼外，随身没有带别的食物。

text_en: And he cautioned them, saying, “Watch out—beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and the yeast of Herod. ”
text_cn: 耶稣嘱咐他们说：“你们应当谨慎，提防法利塞人的酵母和黑落德的酵母。”

text_en: They said to one another, “It is because we have no bread. ”
text_cn: 他们彼此议论：他们没有饼了。

text_en: And becoming aware of it, Jesus said to them, “Why are you talking about having no bread? Do you still not perceive or understand? Are your hearts hardened?
text_cn: 耶稣看出来了，就对他们说：“为什么你们议论没有饼了？你们还不明白，还不了解吗？你们的心仍然迟钝吗？

text_en: Do you have eyes, and fail to see? Do you have ears, and fail to hear? And do you not remember?
text_cn: 你们有眼看不见，有耳听不见吗？你们不记得：

text_en: When I broke the five loaves for the five thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you collect? ” They said to him, “Twelve. ”
text_cn: 当我掰开五个饼给五千人的时候，你们收满了几筐碎块？”他们回答说：“十二筐。”

text_en: “And the seven for the four thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you collect? ” And they said to him, “Seven. ”
text_cn: “还有，七个饼给四千人的时候，你们收满了几篮碎块？”他们回答说：“七篮。”

text_en: Then he said to them, “Do you not yet understand? ”
text_cn: 于是耶稣对他们说：“你们还不了解吗？”

text_en: They came to Bethsaida. Some people brought a blind man to him and begged him to touch him.
text_cn: 他们来到贝特赛达，有人给耶稣送来一个瞎子，求他抚摸他。

text_en: He took the blind man by the hand and led him out of the village; and when he had put saliva on his eyes and laid his hands on him, he asked him, “Can you see anything? ”
text_cn: 耶稣便拉着瞎子的手，领他到村外，在他的眼上吐了唾沫，然后又给他覆手，问他说：“你看见什么没有？”

text_en: And the man looked up and said, “I can see people, but they look like trees, walking. ”
text_cn: 他举目一望，说：“我看见人，见他们好像树木在行走。”

text_en: Then Jesus laid his hands on his eyes again; and he looked intently and his sight was restored, and he saw everything clearly.
text_cn: 然后，耶稣又按手在他的眼上，他定睛一看，就复了原，竟能清清楚楚看见一切。

text_en: Then he sent him away to his home, saying, “Do not even go into the village. ”
text_cn: 耶稣打发他回家去说：“连这村庄你也不要进去。”

text_en: Jesus went on with his disciples to the villages of Caesarea Philippi; and on the way he asked his disciples, “Who do people say that I am? ”
text_cn: 耶稣和他的门徒起身，往斐理伯的凯撒勒雅附近的村庄去；在路上问自己的门徒说：“人们说我是谁？”

text_en: And they answered him, “John the Baptist; and others, Elijah; and still others, one of the prophets. ”
text_cn: 他们回答说：“是洗者若翰；也有些人说是厄里亚；还有些人说是先知中的一位。”

text_en: He asked them, “But who do you say that I am? ” Peter answered him, “You are the Messiah. ”
text_cn: 耶稣又问他们说：“你们说我是谁呢？”伯多禄回答说：“你是默西亚。”

text_en: And he sternly ordered them not to tell anyone about him.
text_cn: 耶稣就严禁他们，不要向任何人谈及他。

text_en: Then he began to teach them that the Son of Man must undergo great suffering, and be rejected by the elders, the chief priests, and the scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.
text_cn: 耶稣便开始教训他们：人子必须受许多苦，被长老、司祭长和经师弃绝，且要被杀害；但三天以后必要复活。

text_en: He said all this quite openly. And Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him.
text_cn: 耶稣明明说了这话。伯多禄便拉他到一边，开始谏责他。

text_en: But turning and looking at his disciples, he rebuked Peter and said, “Get behind me, Satan! For you are setting your mind not on divine things but on human things. ”
text_cn: 耶稣却转过身来，注视着自己的门徒，责斥伯多禄说：“撒殚，退到我后面去！因为你所体会的，不是天主的事，而是人的事。”

text_en: He called the crowd with his disciples, and said to them, “If any want to become my followers, let them deny themselves and take up their cross and follow me.
text_cn: 他遂召集群众和门徒来，对他们说：“谁若愿意跟随我，该弃绝自己，背着自己的十字架，跟随我，

text_en: For those who want to save their life will lose it, and those who lose their life for my sake, and for the sake of the gospel, will save it.
text_cn: 因为谁若愿意救自己的性命，必要丧失性命；但谁若为我和福音的原故，丧失自己的性命，必要救得性命。

text_en: For what will it profit them to gain the whole world and forfeit their life?
text_cn: 人纵然赚得了全世界而赔上自己的灵魂，为他有什么益处？

text_en: Indeed, what can they give in return for their life?
text_cn: 人还能拿什么作为自己灵魂的代价？

text_en: Those who are ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, of them the Son of Man will also be ashamed when he comes in the glory of his Father with the holy angels. ”
text_cn: 谁若在这淫乱和罪恶的世代中，以我和我的话为耻，将来人子在他父的光荣中，同诸圣天使降来时，也要以他为耻。”
